summary: Iteration 6 — Verified the Level-4 button-enabled fix (both 'Add Test Manually' and 'Select & Upload File' are no longer gated by the bucket useQuery loading/retry window). BACKEND: Re-ran /app/backend/tests/test_sample_template_and_upload.py against https://dakmock-exam.preview.emergentagent.com — 7/7 passed (public GET /api/admin/sample-template → 200 xlsx with correct Content-Type/Disposition; POST /api/admin/bulk-upload-tagged → 200 for both gds_mts/true/mock and pa_sa/false/pyq buckets consuming /app/sample_questions.xlsx; anon upload → 401/403). FRONTEND (Playwright, mobile 390x844): logged in admin@dakmock.com/Admin@123, drilled gds_mts → Free → Mock. Within ~30ms of reaching level-4 (no artificial wait): add-manual aria-disabled=None, opacity=1; bulk-upload-tagged aria-disabled=None, opacity=1; bucket-retry card NOT rendered. Tap add-manual → navigates to /admin/test-editor?seriesId=series_27bd1b5695 (ensure-series was called on demand in the handler). Returned to lvl4 — tap bulk-upload-tagged opened the native filechooser; after fc.set_files('/app/sample_questions.xlsx') the upload completed in one step and the manage-test row count rose to 5. Repeated identically in bucket2 (pa_sa → Paid → PYQ): both buttons enabled immediately (~27ms, opacity=1, aria-disabled=None, no retry card), add-manual navigated to /admin/test-editor?seriesId=series_5bae907017, bulk-upload-tagged → filechooser → one-step upload succeeded, list refreshed to 4 rows. Deprecated RN Web warnings (pointerEvents, shadow*) still emitted on manage-screen render — unchanged carry-over from iter 4/5.

react_native_issues.issue: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' emitted on every manage-screen render. Move pointerEvents from props to style. Reference: /app/frontend/app/admin/manage.tsx and shared Card/Pressable wrappers.
'"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' Replace shadow* in StyleSheet.create blocks with boxShadow. Reference: /app/frontend/app/admin/manage.tsx uploadCard styles.

action_items: (Carry-over, cosmetic) Replace deprecated RN Web props: props.pointerEvents → style.pointerEvents, shadow* → boxShadow. No functional impact.

(Nice-to-have) addManual's on-demand ensure-series call duplicates the queryFn logic from the useQuery. Consider extracting ensureSeries(cat,isFree,stype) into a shared helper so both paths stay in sync if the payload shape changes.
critical_code_review_comments: manage.tsx line 155: Pressable is `disabled={uploading}` — correct (only disabled during active upload). Good: no longer gated by bucket.isLoading / bucket.data.
manage.tsx line 55-66: addManual now calls ensure-series on demand when bucket.data?.series_id is undefined — this correctly decouples the button from the useQuery loading window.

server.py still ~1553 lines — admin/* endpoints should be split into routers for maintainability (ensure-series, bulk-upload-tagged, sample-template, tests CRUD, series CRUD, announcements). Carry-over from iter 5.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — both buckets (gds_mts/Free/Mock and pa_sa/Paid/PYQ) show add-manual and bulk-upload-tagged enabled (aria-disabled=None, opacity=1) within 30ms of reaching level-4, both tap handlers work (navigation to /admin/test-editor with on-demand ensure-series, and filechooser → one-step upload → list refresh).

seed_data_creation: Playwright uploaded /app/sample_questions.xlsx into gds_mts/Free/Mock (manage-test row count = 5 after upload) and pa_sa/Paid/PYQ (row count = 4). rca_of_issue: No new bugs. The previously-reported bug (both lvl4 buttons faded/disabled during bucket query loading/retry window) is confirmed fixed in /app/frontend/app/admin/manage.tsx: (1) add-manual Pressable no longer references bucket.data in its render and calls ensure-series inside its onPress handler on demand; (2) bulk-upload-tagged Pressable's disabled prop is `uploading` only (not bucket.isLoading or !bucket.data).
